lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\CustomizedEmails\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
1 class in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\CustomizedEmails, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
4 uses of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.
appinfo/info.xml names 1 class that appinfo/ and lib/ do not have. The server fails when it comes to load one.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
